Problem: Given that \( n! \), in decimal notation, has exactly 57 ending zeros, find the sum of all possible values of \( n \).

<reflection>
The number of trailing zeros in $n!$ is $Z(n)=\left\lfloor n/5\right\rfloor+\left\lfloor n/25\right\rfloor+\left\lfloor n/125\right\rfloor+\left\lfloor n/625\right\rfloor+\cdots$. $Z(225)=55$, $Z(230)=56$, $Z(235)=57$, and $Z(240)=58$. The possible values of $n$ with $Z(n)=57$ are $n=235,236,237,238,239$.
The arithmetic is incorrect: 235 + 236 + 237 + 238 + 239 equals 1185, not 1155.
Recompute the sum of 235, 236, 237, 238, and 239 correctly.
</reflection>
